rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8 and 13: the prototype wins by default and a question is raised only when neither the default nor DR1 settles a difference; here the prototype's only target for both links is its index of design releases, which req-1681 already rules out as prototype tooling, so the prototype names no destination a real service can have, no DR1 judgement covers the header links, and the next-ranked sources that do name a buildable target (repo:frontend, repo:insfrontend) stand.
outcome: Keep the current targets. The GOV.UK logo links to https://www.gov.uk/ on both frontends, as the GOV.UK header pattern does. The service name links to each frontend's dashboard home: /live-animals on the animals frontend and / on the INS frontend, wherever the dashboard area finally puts the dashboard. The prototype sends both links to its index of design releases, which is prototype tooling that is not built (req-1681), so it names no real destination to move them to; the prototype keeps a separate Dashboard item, so its index is not a stand-in for the dashboard. With no DR1 judgement on the header links, the real frontends' targets are the only buildable ones and stand.
